title: reconcile fanout cap drift CLAUDE.md vs code
body_md: Commit 0626d37 removed the fanout cap of 5 from bookie-validator/ledger code, but CLAUDE.md still says 'Fanout cap = 5, recursion allowed' and bin/ledger.test.ts:235 'decompose: fanout cap of 5 enforced' still fails. Pick a direction: (a) re-instate the cap, or (b) delete the test + update CLAUDE.md. Recommend (b) since the code already removed it intentionally — but require an ADR or CHOICES note explaining why removal was the right call (uncapped recursion has obvious risks).
acceptance_md: bun test passes (failing test resolved either way); CLAUDE.md + (ADR or CHOICES) consistent with code; commit message references the discrepancy.
evidence_md: Added CHOICES G-0009 (no hardcoded fanout cap), updated CLAUDE.md decomposition paragraph, deleted fanout-cap-5 test in bin/ledger.test.ts, restored hooks/pre-commit-slice-guard.sh. bun test bin/ledger.test.ts: 15 pass / 0 fail. Commit e722e5b on branch worker/factory-metrics-endpoint cites 0626d37.
